programs.name: sureflpsvsh
programs.purpose: Model PSV or SH seismograms for a horizontally layered elastic earth using the reflectivity method.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUREFLPSVSH - REFlectivity modeling of either PSV or SH waves for layered

params.name: stype
params.description: Source representation; 1 computes the moment tensor and 2 reads its components.

params.name: wfield
params.description: Output displacement, velocity, or acceleration; the selfdoc says 2, but the code uses 1.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Processing information destination; values 2 or 3 are needed to initialize outfp before an unconditional fprintf.

params.name: p2w
params.description: Maximum ray parameter; despite the selfdoc, the code supplies a default.

params.name: m1
params.description: Moment tensor component; required when stype=2.

params.name: m2
params.description: Moment tensor component; required when stype=2.

params.name: m3
params.description: Moment tensor component; required when stype=2.

params.name: wrefp
params.description: P reference frequency for Q correction.

params.name: wrefs
params.description: S reference frequency for Q correction.

params.name: nlayers
params.default: computed: number of cl values when clfile is empty
params.description: Layer count; required with clfile, and a supplied value subsequently overrides the computed count.

params.name: cl
params.description: P velocities, unless clfile supplies them.

params.name: ct
params.description: S velocities, unless ctfile supplies them; the length check mistakenly checks cl.

params.name: ql
params.description: P Q values, unless qlfile supplies them; its count must equal nlayers.

params.name: qt
params.description: S Q values, unless qtfile supplies them; its count must equal nlayers.

params.name: rho
params.description: Densities, unless rhofile supplies them; its count must equal nlayers.

params.name: t
params.description: Layer thicknesses, unless tfile supplies them; its count must equal nlayers.

params.name: lobs
params.description: Receiver layer indices; absent values leave allocated entries uninitialized.

params.name: nlint
params.description: Interpolation count; normally computed from intlayers. The documented file branch is unreachable because intlayfile is never read.

params.name: nintlayers
params.description: Numbers of interpolated layers; count must match intlayers when supplied.

params.name: intlayth
params.description: Interpolation thicknesses; count must match intlayers when supplied.

params.name: layer
params.description: Random-layer insertion index; read only when rand=1 and otherwise uninitialized.

params.name: nrand_layers
params.description: Random-layer capacity; when rand=1 it has no initialized default.

params.name: zlayer
params.description: Random-layer thickness; no initialized default when rand=1.

params.name: sdcl
params.description: Random P-velocity standard deviation; no initialized default when rand=1.

params.name: sdct
params.description: Random S-velocity standard deviation; no initialized default when rand=1.

params.name: outf
params.description: Processing information file when verbose=2 or 3.

params.name: nfilters
params.description: Filter count; documented file branch is unreachable.

params.name: filters_phase
params.description: Filter phases; count must equal filters_type.

params.name: dbpo
params.description: Filter slopes; count must equal filters_type.

params.name: f1
params.description: Filter start frequencies; count must equal filters_type.

params.name: f2
params.description: Filter end frequencies; count must equal filters_type.

params.name: lobsfile
params.description: Documented receiver-layer file, but the program never reads this parameter.

params.name: intlayfile
params.description: Documented interpolation file, but the program never reads this parameter.

params.name: nintlayfile
params.description: Documented interpolation-count file, but the program never reads this parameter.

params.name: intlaythfile
params.description: Documented interpolation-thickness file, but the program never reads this parameter.

params.name: filtypefile
params.description: Documented filter-type file, but the program never reads this parameter.

params.name: fphfile
params.description: Documented filter-phase file, but the program never reads this parameter.

params.name: dbpofile
params.description: Documented filter-slope file, but the program never reads this parameter.

params.name: f1file
params.description: Documented filter-frequency file, but the program never reads this parameter.

params.name: f2file
params.description: Documented filter-frequency file, but the program never reads this parameter.

params.name: w1
params.description: Documented lower window frequency; initialized but never read from getpar.

params.name: w2
params.description: Documented upper window frequency; initialized but never read from getpar.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Reflectivity integration, complex arithmetic and wavelet transforms depend on numerical accumulation and library math. random_velocity_layers is called when rand=1. The program unconditionally writes through outfp even though it is NULL unless verbose=2 or 3; several optional arrays and random-layer variables can remain uninitialized. The ct length check mistakenly checks cl.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program orchestrates reflectivity modeling, slowness integration, layer interpolation, filtering and several output components.

test_cases.description: Small PSV model with explicit source and processing file.
test_cases.command: sureflpsvsh m0=1 stype=2 m1=1 m2=0 m3=1 verbose=2 outf=info nlayers=2 cl=2,3 ct=1,1.5 ql=100,100 qt=50,50 rho=2,2.2 t=1,1 lobs=0 nor=1 nx=2 nt=64 tsec=0.256 dt=0.004 nw=16 nf=16 np=32 wfp=p.su wfr=r.su wfz=z.su

test_cases.description: Small SH model with fault-plane source and frequency window.
test_cases.command: sureflpsvsh m0=1 stype=1 delta=45 lambda=90 phis=0 phi=30 wtype=2 win=1 verbose=2 outf=info nlayers=2 cl=2,3 ct=1,1.5 ql=100,100 qt=50,50 rho=2,2.2 t=1,1 lobs=0 nor=1 nx=2 nt=64 tsec=0.256 dt=0.004 nw=16 nf=16 np=32 wft=t.su

programs.license_note: Credits say the PSV Fortran version was written by Subshashis Mallick and the SH version by Mrinal Sen, then translated and expanded by Gabriel Alvarez.

programs.name: elaps
programs.purpose: Plot a triangulated elastic model as shaded PostScript.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: ELAPS - plot a triangulated function p(x,z) via PostScript

params.name: p
params.description: Field: P velocity, S velocity, epsilon-like quantity, or gamma.

params.name: pgmin
params.default: computed: minimum selected field in model

params.name: pgmax
params.default: computed: maximum selected field in model

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Uses square roots and floating-point scaling; p=2 divides the velocity difference by a3333. minmax does not advance past a face without attributes, causing an infinite loop.
programs.difficulty_reason: It traverses a triangulated model and generates a shaded PostScript plot.

test_cases.command: elamodel fill=0.5,0.5,2,1,2 > model.bin && elaps p=0 < model.bin > model.ps

test_cases.description: Plot gamma with normal axes and a dashed grid.
test_cases.command: elamodel fill=0.5,0.5,2,1,0.1,0.05,0.1,0,2 > model.bin && elaps p=3 style=normal gridx=dash gtri=-1 < model.bin > gamma.ps

programs.name: elacheck
programs.purpose: Interactively report stiffness coefficients and vertical velocities at points in an elastic model.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: ELACHECK - get elastic coefficients of model
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Uses sqrt for velocities; a face without attributes retains the previous point's values. The interactive loop does not check scanf failures.
programs.difficulty_reason: It looks up a model triangle and reports its attributes interactively.

test_cases.command:
elamodel fill=0.5,0.5,2,1,2 > model.bin && printf '0.5
0.5
0
' | elacheck file=model.bin

elamodel fill=0.5,0.5,2,1,0.1,0.05,0.1,15,2 > model.bin && printf '0.25
0.25
0
' | elacheck file=model.bin

programs.name: elamodel
programs.purpose: Build a triangulated piecewise homogeneous elastic model from interfaces and material properties.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: ELAMODEL - make piecewise homogeneous anisotropic model

params.name: maxangle
params.description: Maximum angle in degrees between smoothed edge segments.

params.name: xedge
params.description: Repeatable horizontal interface coordinates; each occurrence must match zedge.

params.name: zedge
params.description: Repeatable vertical interface coordinates; each occurrence must match xedge.

params.name: kedge
params.description: One index per interface; required when edges are supplied.

params.name: fill
params.description: Repeatable region seed and material properties; each occurrence has 5, 9, or 12 values.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Spline interpolation, edge subdivision, triangulation, tensor rotation and square roots depend on floating-point rounding and geometry comparisons; the output is a native binary model.
programs.difficulty_reason: It constructs and fills a triangulated model using curved interfaces and anisotropic tensor transformations.

test_cases.command: elamodel xmin=0 xmax=1 zmin=0 zmax=1 fill=0.5,0.5,2,1,2 > model.bin

test_cases.description: Two regions separated by an indexed interface.

programs.name: elaray
programs.purpose: Trace elastic rays through a triangulated anisotropic model and write their endpoints.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: ELARAY - ray tracing for elastic anisotropic models

params.name: mode
params.description: Initial wave mode: P, SV, or SH.

params.name: nxz
params.description: Number of coordinates per ray in rayfile.

params.name: prim
params.description: Select direct or reflected rays; prim=1 requires refseq.

params.name: refseq
params.description: Repeatable interface index followed by interaction sequence.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Ray-interface intersections, anisotropic slowness solutions, polarization and reflection/transmission coefficients use iterative and transcendental numerical calculations. RayEnd output is a native C structure and is ABI dependent.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program traces and converts multiple wave modes across triangulated interfaces and computes ray amplitudes.

test_cases.command: elamodel fill=0.5,0.5,2,1,2 > model.bin && elaray nangle=9 fangle=-30 langle=30 xs=0.5 zs=0.01 outparfile=outpar < model.bin > rays.bin

test_cases.description: Trace SV rays and write paths.
test_cases.command: elamodel fill=0.5,0.5,2,1,2 > model.bin && elaray mode=1 nangle=9 fangle=-30 langle=30 xs=0.5 zs=0.01 rayfile=paths.bin nxz=32 outparfile=outpar < model.bin > rays.bin

programs.license_note: The author states that the program is based on gbray.c and sdray.c.

programs.name: elasyn
programs.purpose: Build horizontal and vertical synthetic seismograms from elastic ray endpoints.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: ELASYN - SYNthetic seismograms for triangulated elastic media

params.name: xg
params.description: Receiver surface horizontal coordinates; count must equal zg.

params.name: zg
params.description: Receiver surface vertical coordinates; count must equal xg.

params.name: lscale
params.default: computed: (maximum selected x - minimum selected x)*20/number of input ray ends

params.name: reftrans
params.description: Reflection/transmission option; the program warns that it is unsupported.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Spline and arrival interpolation, ray Jacobians, complex FFTs and trigonometric recurrence mix float and double. The source documents an interpolation crash; makexzs reads s[-1], interpara reads beyond the final input, writeinfo reads one endpoint past the end, and empty or single-ray input can also access out of bounds.
programs.difficulty_reason: It interpolates multiple ray arrivals and synthesizes component traces in the frequency domain, with several unsafe boundary cases.

test_cases.description: Generate a small ray fan and horizontal synthetics.
test_cases.command: elamodel fill=0.5,0.5,2,1,2 > model.bin && elaray nangle=16 fangle=-30 langle=30 xs=0.5 zs=0.01 outparfile=outpar < model.bin > rays.bin && elasyn xg=0,1 zg=1,1 ng=16 nt=64 dt=0.004 compon=1 inter=0 xfile=x.bin < rays.bin

test_cases.description: Generate vertical synthetics with parabolic interpolation.
test_cases.command: elamodel fill=0.5,0.5,2,1,2 > model.bin && elaray nangle=16 fangle=-30 langle=30 xs=0.5 zs=0.01 outparfile=outpar < model.bin > rays.bin && elasyn xg=0,1 zg=1,1 ng=16 nt=64 dt=0.004 compon=3 inter=1 zfile=z.bin < rays.bin

programs.license_note: The authors state that the program is based on gbbeam.c and sdbeam.c.
